entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something. I'm just a bit confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me which item you're looking to return?
It's a helmet. I ordered it a while ago, but the color... it just wasn't what I expected when it arrived. I'm not sure if it's too late.
Not a problem. Let's take a look. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so. It's... uh... VF-886-2154. Is that right? I get so overwhelmed with these things. The box is unopened, I never even took it out.
Yes, that's the one. Let me pull it up. I see you ordered the Apex Road Helmet, delivered about 55 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that bad? Am I too late? Can't you just help me? I just want the right color.
No, you are perfectly fine. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since it's been 55 days, you are well within the window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief!
Absolutely. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that makes it even easier. For safety reasons, we can only accept a helmet if it's in its original, unused condition.
It is! I promise. I never even touched it.

Great. I've just initiated the return for you in our system. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. You've been a huge help.
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
